title: Past Perfect / Guyyaa lamaa hojiin (guyyaa guyyaa lamaa hojii)
bridge: Afaan Ingilifiz, guyyaa lamaa hojiin (had eaten) barbaachisaa tokko lamaa hojii tokkoo hin jiruuf barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru ta'e malee, akkasiif qorattoota girmaataa kan dandeessan: qorattoota seenaa akkasiif kan dandeessan (Afaan Ingilifiz 'had + participio' hin jiru), afaan Ingilifiz 'already', 'just', 'never' hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan. Haala dhaabbata: afaan Ispeenyaa, guyyaa lamaa hojii (comí) hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan, afaan Ingilifiz guyyaa lamaa hojiin (had eaten) hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan. Akkasumas, afaan Ispeenyaa, guyyaa lamaa hojii 'haber' hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan, afaan Ingilifiz 'had' hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan.
rule: Guyyaa lamaa hojiin 'had' (barbaachisaa tokko) + participio lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan. Barbaachisaa tokko lamaa hojii tokkoo hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan, guyyaa 'lamaa hojii lamaa hojii' hin jiru. Afaan Ingilifiz: barbaachisaa + had + participio. Afaan Ispeenyaa: had not (hadn't) + participio. Afaan Ingilifiz: Had + barbaachisaa + participio. 'Already', 'just', 'never', 'ever', 'by the time', 'before', 'after' hin jiru. Misola: 'I had finished my homework before dinner' (guyyaa lamaa hojii hin jiru). Akkasumas, guyyaa lamaa hojiin (present perfect -> past perfect) hin jiru. Akkasumas: afaan Ingilifiz 'after' fi 'before' hin jiru guyyaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan, guyyaa lamaa hojiin barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan. Haala dhaabbata: afaan Ispeenyaa, guyyaa lamaa hojii hin jiru barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan; afaan Ingilifiz, guyyaa lamaa hojiin barbaachisaa lamaa hojii hin jiru kan dandeessan.

title: Passive Voice: Present & Past / Lafa qabu: Hojiin fi Daabboo
bridge: Afaan Oromo, lafa qabu qabiyyee 'be' + lafa qabuu barbaachisaa ta'e malee, Afaan Ingilizii (to be + past participle) dubbii akkas akkaataa. Haata'u Afaan Ingilizii kan lafa qabuu barbaachisaa 'by' jechuun isaa hin kennu; Afaan Oromootti 'by' hin kennine. Afaan Ingilizii kan lafa qabuu barbaachisaa qajeelfama isaaniif kennuudha. Akkasumas, Afaan Oromootti lafa qabuu barbaachisaa hin kennu; lafa qabuu barbaachisaa 'se' jechuun isaa kennu.
rule: Lafa qabuu qabiyyee 'be' jechuun isaaniif kennuudha. Kan lafa qabuu barbaachisaa 'by' jechuun isaa kennuudha (haata'u kan lafa qabuu barbaachisaa hin kennuudha). title: Reported Speech / Qabxii adabii xixinnoo
bridge: Afaan Oromo, qabxii adabii xixinnoo guddaa kennu malee, afaan Ingiliffaa kan qabxii adabii xixinnoo godhatudha. Verbs, pronouns, time and place adverbs (today→that day, here→there), fi qabxii adabii xixinnoo kennu. Akkasumas, afaan Oromo 'that' preposition hin jiru, afaan Ingiliffa 'that' hin jiran. Akkasumas, afaan Oromo 'que' hin jiru, afaan Ingiliffa 'that' hin jiran.
rule: Qabxii adabii xixinnoo kan biraa deebii godhaa. Afaan Ingiliffa, 'say' ama 'tell' verbs godhaa. 'Say' object personal hin qabnu (He said he was happy), 'tell' object personal qabnu (He told me he was happy). Kennfoomota: 1) Verbs (present→past, past→past perfect): 'I am' → 'she was', 'I went' → 'she had gone'. 2) Pronouns: 'I' → 'he/she', 'my' → 'his/her'. 3) Time adverbs: 'today'→'that day', 'tomorrow'→'the next day', 'yesterday'→'the day before'. 4) Place: 'here'→'there'. Exception: if the action is still true or time has not passed, the original tense can be maintained (She said she is tired - if she is still tired). For questions, 'if' or 'whether' is used for yes/no questions, and the interrogative word for open questions, with affirmative order (He asked me where I lived, not 'where did I live'). For orders/requests, 'tell/ask + person + to + infinitive' is used (He told me to sit down).

bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, infinitiviin (to + haala) haalaa tokko akkasumas haalaa hedduu barbaachisaa kan hin ta’in, gerund (haala + -ing) barbaachisaa kan ta’e. Qorannaa umrii: haalaa tokko gosaa qabdu akkasumas haalaa hedduu barbaachisaa kan ta’e, gerund (haala + -ing) barbaachisaa kan ta’e. Haalaa tokko akkasumas haalaa hedduu barbaachisaa kan ta’e, infinitiviin (to + haala) barbaachisaa kan ta’e. Kana malee, haalaa tokko akkasumas haalaa hedduu barbaachisaa kan ta’e, gerund (haala + -ing) barbaachisaa kan ta’e. Haalaa tokko akkasumas haalaa hedduu barbaachisaa kan ta’e, infinitiviin (to + haala) barbaachisaa kan ta’e.
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, haalaa lamaan hin qabne lamaan tokko dhaabbata: gerund (haala + -ing) fi infinitiviin (to + haalaa lamaan). title: Modal Verbs for Deduction / Modalaatiin deddeshaa (must, might, could)
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, ‘kan hin argamu’ jechuun deddeshaa kan itti sodaatamuu dha, ‘dhaabbata’ jechuunis haala dhaabbataa ta’ee jiraatu dha. Hegaaddan, afaan Ingilizii keessatti walitti dhiisuu miti. Modalaatiin hin qajeelenne ‘to’ hin qabshan. Fakkeenyaa kanarraa, afaan Oromootti akkas jechuu danda’a: ‘Ishee kan hin argamuu dha’ (She must be at home). Hegaaddan, afaan Ingilizii keessatti ‘must’ + feexxi qabaasaa jechuudha. Kana malee, ‘must’ jechuu ‘kan hin argamu’ jechuu miti.
rule:
Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, deddeshaa umrii keessatti ‘must’, ‘might’, ‘could’ jechuudha. 
- **Must** + feexxi qabaasaa: deddeshaa kan itti sodaatamuu miti. Fakkeenya: ‘She must be at home’ (Ishee mana hin argamu dha). 
- **Might** + feexxi qabaasaa: haala dhaabbataa ta’ee jiraatu miti. Fakkeenya: ‘He might be sick’ (Isaan dhaabbata ta’ee jiraachuu danda’a). 
- **Could** + feexxi qabaasaa: haala dhaabbataa ta’ee jiraatu miti, garuu kanatti sodaatamu miti. Fakkeenya: ‘It could rain today’ (Haalatti garuu ba’uu danda’a). 

**Qoropha:** Modalaatiin namoonni hin qajeelu (he/she/it keessatti ‘-s’ hin darri). ‘To’ hin qabshan. ‘Must’ jechuu deddeshaa keessatti ‘can’t’ jechuudha lafa. Fakkeenya: ‘She can’t be at work’ (Ishee mana hin jiru dha). 

**Miidhaa:** Deddeshaa umrii keessatti miidhaa. Deddeshaa itti fufuu keessatti ‘must have + feexxi qabaasaa’, ‘might have + feexxi qabaasaa’ jechuudha lafa, garuu kana malees jiru. 

**Gaddisiisuu:** ‘Must’ jechuu walitti dhiisuu hin dandeenye; ‘Do you think...’ jechuu akkasumas walitti dhiisuu danda’a.

title: Relative Clauses: Defining vs. Non-Defining / Qoodaatiwwan wal-qixaataa fi wal-qixaataa
bridge: Afaan Oromo, qoodaatiwwan wal-qixaataa fi wal-qixaataa hin jiru qoodaatiin komaa: wal-qixaataa komaa hin qabdu. Afaan Ingilizii, komaa duraatiin, qoodaatiin wal-qixaataa fi wal-qixaataa qoodaatiin 'that' fi 'which/who' barbaadu. Heca: Afaan Ingilizii, 'that' wal-qixaataa keessatti hin barbaachu.
rule: Qoodaatiwwan wal-qixaataa (qoodaatiin adhaa lamaan hin argamu) komaa hin qabdu fi 'that' ama 'who/which' barbaadu. Akkaan akka ta'ee, 'that' (ama qoodaatiin lamaan hin argamu) hin qabdu: 'The book (that) I bought'. Wal-qixaataa (maltuumaalaa dura hin danda'amu) komaa qabdu fi 'who' lamaan hin argamuu fi 'which' lamaan hin argamuu barbaadu, 'that' hin barbaadu. Qoodaatiwwan wal-qixaataa keessatti hin qabdu. Faayidaa: Defining: 'The woman who lives next door is a doctor.' (Obboleetti wal-gamadii ta'e irra jiraa). Non-defining: 'My sister, who lives in Madrid, is a doctor.' (Wajjin, wal-gamadii Madrid irra jiraa, irratti irra jiraa).

title: Wish + past / Gaaffii hojii irra hin kennan dhaabbataa
bridge: Afaan Oromootti 'gaaffii' 'yoo haa ta'ee' akkas umrii irra jiraatanii hojii irra hin kennan dhaabbataa barbaachisaa qaba. Afaan Ingilizitti, 'wish' mana barreeffame (simple) akkas umrii irra jiraatanii hojii irra hin kennan dhaabbataa barbaachisaa qaba. Dhugumatti 'I wish I have...' 'I wish I would have...' jedhanii afaan Ispeenichaa irra deebi'ee akkas umrii qabuu danda'a. Fakkeenya: mana barreeffame afaan Ingilizii keessatti hojii irra hin kennan dhaabbataa qaba, hin kenninaa ta'u malee.
rule: Qorannaa asaa: **wish + macaafaa + mana barreeffame** hojii irra hin kennan dhaabbataa barbaachisaa qaba. Fakkeenya: 'I wish I knew the answer' (Hundumaa hin kennani). Hojiin irra hin kennan dhaabbataa barbaachisaa qaba (haa ta'ee hin jedhe), **wish + mana barreeffamee dheehii** qaba ('I wish I had studied more'). 'Would' wish keessatti hin kennamne dhugaarii macaafan tokko tokko irra jiraachuu qaba (I wish I would... dhiiseessa ta'e); 'would' namoonni tokko tokko irra jiraachuu qaba (I wish you would stop). 'Wish' + 'were' hin kennamne dhugaarii 'was' hin kennamne dhugaarii (akkas umrii afaan Ingilizii irra deebi'ee akkasii qaba). 'Wish' hojii irra hin kennan dhaabbataa qaba; hojii irra kennan dhaabbataa 'hope' qaba (I hope you come).

title: Used to / Mana murti'ee qabdu
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, mana murti'ee qabdu kennu ‘qabdu’ jechuudhaan isaanii fi qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammadu. Afaan Ingilizii, 'used to' mana murti'ee qabduu qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu danda'a. Dhugaa tokko ilaalchisee 'used to' fi 'be used to' (kana qabdu) jechuu akkasumas 'use to' jedhuu dha. Fakkeenya, seena qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu 'didn't use to' jechuudhaan qabna; seena qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu 'Did you use to?' jechuudhaan qabna.
rule: ‘Used to’ mana murti'ee qabduu qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu danda'a. Fakkeenya: qabdu + used to + macaaf qabdu. Mana murti'ee hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu ‘usually’ + macaaf qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu danda'a. Seena qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu: didn't use to + macaaf qabdu. Seena qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu: Did + qabdu + use to + macaaf qabdu? (dhihaa -d). Dhugaa: ‘I use to’ jechuu mana murti'ee qabduu qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu danda'a, ‘used to’ jechuu qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu danda'a. ‘Would’ mana murti'ee qabduu qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu danda'a, laikin qabduu hojii irra deebii akkan gammachiisuu hin dandeengu.

title: Purpose, Cause and Result / Maali, Sababoo fi Netela
bridge: Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, 'para que' jechuun maaliin dhuunfachuudha 'porque' jechuun sababoon dhuunfachu. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu, 'so that' jechuun maaliin dhuunfachuudha 'because (of)' jechuun sababoon dhuunfachu. Guyyaa tokko 'so that' garuu qabeessa (macaaf + amala) hin kennamne garuu, 'because of' qabeessa macaaf qaban jedha. Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti 'so' (himaa 'that' hin qabne) netelaa dhuunfachu, Afaan Ispaanii keessatti 'así que' kana 'por lo tanto' jedha.
rule:
Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti maali, sababoo fi netelaa dhuufan irratti qabanii waljiraa hojjetan:
- **Maali:** 'so that' (para que) + qabeessa amalaa (can, could, will, would) kana aadaa sadii. Fakkeenya: 'I study so that I can pass the exam.' 'in order to' (para) + amalaa hojjetuudha dhufuu danda'a, garuu kanarraa jiraatanii akkas jedha.
- **Sababoo:** 'because' (porque) + qabeessa, kana 'because of' (debido a) + macaaf kana guyyaa macaafa. Fakkeenya: 'She stayed home because she was sick' (qabeessa) vs. 'She stayed home because of the rain' (macaaf).
- **Netela:** 'so' (así que) + qabeessa netelaa. Fakkeenya: 'It was raining, so we stayed home.' 'therefore' (por lo tanto) kanarraa jiraatanii akkas jedha.
- **Afaan Ispaanii tokko:** Afaan Ispaanii keessatti, 'para que' jechuun subjunctive (subjuntivo) dhuunfachu ('para que estudies'), Afaan Ingiliffaa keessatti garuu indicative (indicativo) (hanga 'can' kana 'could' hin kennamne) dhuunfachu. 'so' (netela) 'so that' (maali) hin kennamne dhufii akka ta'e hubatti argita.

title: Common Phrasal Verbs / Phrasal Verbs Dubbiiwwan
bridge: Afaan Oromootti, malee verbs dubbiiwwan hunda beekamsi isaaniif kennu (halaa ‘qabda’, ‘dhiha’), Afaan Ingilizii phrasal verbs malee verbs tokko hanga dhaabata (up, down, off, etc.) hin kennan; mana qooda isaaniif kennu. Halaa ‘get up’ hin jechu ‘dhaabata qabda’, ‘qabda’ jechu dha. Kabadhuu akakamii kanarraa malee dhaabata hunda beekamsi isaaniif hin kennaniitiin, phrasal verbs dubbiiwwan qindeessan malee dhaabata hunda kennu godhaa (halaa ‘turn the TV off’ kana ‘turn off the TV’), Afaan Oromootti mana qooda hin kennaniin.
rule: Phrasal verb malee verbs hanga dhaabata preposition kana adverb (dhaabata) hin kennaniin. Mana qooda isaaniif hin kennaniin, akkasumas, dubbiiwwan kana hin qabaniif kennu. Akkasumas, lamaan hamma tokko isaaniif kennu: transitive kana intransitive. Transitive lamaan hamma tokko isaaniif kennu: separable kana inseparable. Separable lamaan hamma, object (noun kana pronoun) malee verbs hanga dhaabata hin kennaniin, laakin object pronoun (it, them, etc.) hin kennaniin, malee verbs hanga dhaabata hin kennaniin: ‘turn it off’ (hin jechu ‘turn off it’). Inseparable lamaan hamma, object malee dhaabata hin kennaniin: ‘look after the children’ (hin jechu ‘look children after’). Phrasal verbs dubbiiwwan intransitive lamaan hamma object hin kennaniin: ‘wake up’, ‘grow up’. Mana qooda isaaniif kennu hanga dhaabata hin kennaniin, mana qooda isaaniif kennu hanga dhaabata hin kennaniin.

title: Advanced Quantifiers / Dhaabbata murtiiwwan dhaabbata
bridge: Afaan Oromo, ‘hojii’, ‘dhaabbata’, ‘kan qaba’ jedhanii kennan hundaa’e malee, ingiliziffaa kanarratti dhaabbata murtiiwwan dhaabbata qoodduuwwan ajajni walqixxummaa fi walqarratti dhaabbatanii qoodduuwwan ajajni hojjetan irratti argamsisu. ‘Hardly any’ fi ‘plenty of’ dhaabbatanii tokko tokkoo malee hin qabne; ‘hardly any’ ‘kan’ fi ‘qaba’ hin ta’e malee, ‘plenty of’ ‘hojee hojii’ hin taane. ‘Plenty of’ hamma tokko tokkoonni dhaabbataa ta’u malee, guyyaa fi walqarratti hin amanu. ‘Much/many’ hamma tokko tokkoonni dhaabbataa ta’u.
rule: Ingiliziffaa dhaabbata murtiiwwan dhaabbata (B1): ‘Hardly any’ (kan qaba/qaba hin) guyyaa murtiiwwan dhaabbata qoodduuwwan ajajni hojjetan irratti amanu fi mana qofaa qabna (‘very few’ ykn ‘very little’ jechuudha). ‘Plenty of’ (dhaabbata, hojee hojii) guyyaa murtiiwwan dhaabbata qoodduuwwan ajajni hojjetan irratti amanu (guyyaa fi walqarratti hin amanu). Dhaabbata tokko tokko: ‘a good deal of’ (dhaabbata, hojjetan irratti), ‘a large amount of’ (hojii guutuu, hojjetan irratti), ‘a large number of’ (murtii guutuu, qoodduuwwan ajajni), ‘a couple of’ (lamaan, qoodduuwwan ajajni). ‘Plenty of’ murtii ykn hojjetarra baasu; ajjeesa hin baasu. ‘Hardly any’ murtiiwwan dhaabbata qoodduuwwan ajajni hojjetan irratti baasu fi ‘there is/are’ hin jiru malee amanu. Guyyaa fi walqarratti ‘much’ ykn ‘many’ ‘plenty’ irra deebisu.

title: Verb patterns: verb + infinitive / gerund / Qophi warri: qophicha + gaaffii / gerund
bridge: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, gara qophicha uumamaatiif kennuun gaaffii (ol: 'I want to eat', 'I avoid speaking') barbaachisaa ta'e. Hegaaddis, afaan Ispeenichii keessatti, qophichaa tokko gara qophicha biraatiif kennuun gaaffii (ol: 'quiero comer', 'evito hablar') barbaachisaa ta'e. Hegaaddis, afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, qophichaa lamaan (ol: 'enjoy', 'avoid', 'finish') gerund (-ing) barbaachisu, qophichaa biraatiif (ol: 'want', 'decide', 'hope') gaaffii 'to' hin kennin barbaachisu. Qophichaa lamaan gaaffii yookiin gerund barbaachisuuf argamanii wal qabnu (ol: 'stop to smoke' vs. 'stop smoking'). Kana malee, afaan Ingiliffii garaagaa hojjetan irra deebisuu danda'a.
rule: Afaan Ingiliffii keessatti, qophichaa uumamaatiif gara qophicha biraatiif kennuun lamaan: gaaffii 'to' hin kennin (I want to go) yookiin gerund (-ing) (I enjoy going). Barbaachisuu qophichaa uumamaatiif miti. Seenaa lamaan: - Qophichaa gaaffii barbaachisu: want, need, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, offer, forget, learn, etc. - Qophichaa gerund barbaachisu: enjoy, finish, avoid, mind, consider, suggest, practice, admit, deny, etc. - Qophichaa lamaan gaaffii yookiin gerund barbaachisu: start, begin, continue, like, love, hate, prefer. - Qophichaa argamanii walqabnu: remember, forget, stop, try, regret. (Ol: 'Remember to lock the door' = dhaga'uuf godhaa; 'Remember locking the door' = dhaga'uun godheera). Haala dhiisee: qophichaa hojjetanii fi 'make' fi 'let' keessatti, gaaffii 'to' hin kennin barbaachinu (I saw him leave, They made me wait). Gaaffii yookiin gerund hin kennamne, 'not' barbaachinu (I decided not to go, I enjoy not working).

title: Articles Advanced: Zero Article and Generic Use / Maqaa Tokkoolaa fi Qorophaa Jalaa
bridge: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, haala dhaabbata tokko duubaaf kennu godhi (fakkaataa, 'Dogs are loyal'). Afaan Ispeenii keessatti garuu, maqaa tokkoolaa kanarraa qaba (fakkaataa, 'Los perros son fieles'). Kana malee, afaan Ingilizii keessatti, maqaa tokkoolaa hin qabne yeroo kan dhaabbata tokko duubaaf kennu godha. Haa ta’u malee, afaan Ispeenii keessatti, maqaa tokkoolaa qabda yeroo kan dhaabbata tokko duubaaf kennu godha (fakkaataa, 'Me gusta el arroz').
rule: Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, sadarkaa ‘maqaa tokkoolaa’ hin qabne godhata tokkootti dhufan qabda: 1) Yeroo kan dhaabbata tokko duubaaf kennu godha gara qorophaa qaraqaanotaa fi qaraqaanotaa hin ta’in (fakkaataa, 'Cats are cute', 'Water is essential'). 2) Gara maqaa manhoba, afaan, oluma fi barumsa deebii tokko hin ta’in (fakkaataa, 'I speak English', 'She plays tennis'). 3) Gara institushanolaatiin ‘school’, ‘hospital’, ‘church’, ‘prison’ yeroo kan qorophiisaanii uumameeraa duubaaf kennu godha (fakkaataa, 'He goes to school' - mana qorophaa, hin mana dhalataa). Gahi: Gara qorophaa qaraqaanotaa tokkoottii, maqaa tokkoolaa fi qajeelfama tokko qaba (fakkaataa, 'A dog is man's best friend' fi 'The dog is a loyal animal'). 'Dog is loyal' jedhu hin qabne garuu, qorophaa qaraqaanotaa tokkootti duubaaf kennu hin godhu. Afaan Ingilizii keessatti, ‘the’ hin qabne gara maqaa qoraa hin taaneessu (fakkaataa, 'Italy', 'Spain'), garuu maqaa ‘republic’, ‘kingdom’ fi ‘states’ kan ta’eessu (fakkaataa, 'the United States').
